problem.title: Climbing Stairs
problem.statement: You are climbing a staircase. It takes `n` steps to reach the top. Each time you can either climb 1 or 2 steps. In how many distinct ways can you climb to the top?

hints.title: Observation & Invariants
hints.content: Observe the input constraints of "Climbing Stairs". Analyze whether scanning all combinations exceeds time bounds.
hints.keyTakeaway: Trade space for linear lookup time.

hints.title: Optimal Data Structure
hints.content: Consider using a Hash Map or Two-Pointer approach to eliminate repeated inner loops.
hints.keyTakeaway: Look up previously encountered complements in O(1) time.

hints.title: Edge Cases & Boundaries
hints.content: Watch out for duplicate values, negative numbers, and boundary indexing.
hints.keyTakeaway: Test against identical values summing to target.
